entry.answer: Abigail is an egoist, and Olivia is an altruist.
entry.question: A very special island is inhabited only by altruists and egoists. Altruists always tell the truth, and egoists always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Abigail, and Olivia. In Abigail's words: "Olivia is an altruist if and only if Abigail is an altruist". In Olivia's words: "Olivia is an altruist if and only if Abigail is an egoist". So who is an altruist and who is an egoist? (Format your answer like: "Abigail is a altruist/egoist, and Olivia is a altruist/egoist")
